verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms threejs.org serves llms.txt at the site root (HTTP 200). It points to a docs llms.txt with an explicit '## Instructions for Large Language Models' section and a 363 KB llms-full.txt, and the excerpts show agent-directed guidance such as 'CORRECT - modern pattern' and 'Use Import Maps (Not Old CDN Patterns)'. Missing for 10: per-page markdown or static-URL doc pages (the manual .md probe returned 404 and human docs are hash-routed, so the llms files are the only machine path).
